chapter: Later band, return visits and marching band
title: Return to England, Denmark, and the Barber-Sunshine band
summary: After the immigration matter was sorted out, he started with Chris Barber and Monty Sunshine in 1953, rehearsed in Copenhagen, then broke away after about a year to form his present band, whose members he lists.
